description: Never lose a great ChatGPT recipe again. RecipeBox saves the recipes you generate in ChatGPT to your account — organized, searchable, and ready whenever you want to cook, whether that's tonight or three months from now. And when you're ready to shop, tap Get Ingredients to send the ingredient list straight to Walmart, Instacart, or Kroger.

capabilities: Save recipes to your RecipeBox account
Send recipe ingredients to Walmart, Instacart, or Kroger
defaultPrompt: I need a recipe for an adult macaroni and cheese dish
Create a recipe for a really good and easy dip to take to a football watching party
I need a recipe and ingredients to make dinner tonight in under 30 minutes

name: app-6a4bcf1a1ff88191b311480ac88a2a4a

positive.prompt: I need a recipe for an adult macaroni and cheese dish
positive.expected_behavior: A RecipeBox card shows the recipe title with Get Ingredients and Save recipe buttons. The chat reply includes the ingredients and steps. Nothing is saved.

positive.prompt: Create a recipe for a really good and easy dip to take to a football watching party
positive.expected_behavior: A RecipeBox card appears. Clicking Save recipe asks you to sign in with the test account if not yet connected. The card then shows Saved and "Recipe is in your RecipeBox" with a link to recipebox.com.

positive.prompt: I need a recipe and ingredients to make dinner tonight in under 30 minutes
positive.expected_behavior: A RecipeBox card appears. Clicking Get Ingredients opens eMeals shopping, where you choose Walmart, Instacart, or Kroger with the ingredients already loaded. The recipe is not saved to RecipeBox.

positive.prompt: Give me a recipe for chicken stir fry and save it to my RecipeBox
positive.expected_behavior: The recipe is saved to the test account (sign in if prompted). The card shows Saved and links to recipebox.com. The chat reply includes the ingredients and steps.

positive.prompt: Make me a recipe for beef chili and save it
positive.expected_behavior: The recipe is saved to the test account. Clicking Get Ingredients on the card opens the store picker (Walmart, Instacart, or Kroger) with the chili ingredients loaded. The recipe stays saved.
